description: $0.01 per call — Real-time stock quotes: price, change, change percent, open, high, low, volume, turnover, currency and exchange timestamp. Covers A-shares (sh600000, sz000001), Hong Kong (hk00700) and US (usAAPL or plain AAPL). Accepts several symbols at once separated by commas. No API key needed, sourced from Tencent qt.gtimg.cn with a Nasdaq fallback for US tickers.
